property_summary: After a successful withdrawAll by the owner, the contract's ETH balance must become 0; the bug sends funds to msg.sender (owner) instead of the given recipient, so a recipient that cannot receive ETH will cause a revert in the correct contract but not in the buggy one (or vice versa under different scenarios).
change_summary: Replace payable(_recipient).transfer with payable(msg.sender).transfer, changing who receives the withdrawn funds.
